soldier: Major soldier: head yellowish brown tinged with red, thoracic and abdominal tergites yellowish brown. Head elongate-oval, length about 1.3 times the width, posterior margin broadly rounded; in lateral view the dorsal margin of the head mound-like and arched, the fontanelle situated behind the highest point, the postmentum prominent; labrum lanceolate, the semi-transparent area at the tip of the labrum triangular; mandibles rather stout, about half the length of the head capsule, the middle of the inner margin of the left mandible with indistinct fine teeth, with several incisions near the mandibular base; antennae with 17 segments, segment 3 slightly longer than segment 2, compound eyes dot-like; postmentum about four times as long as wide, the waist region in the anterior third, its sides almost parallel. Anterior and posterior margins of the pronotum both distinctly incised; mesonotum and metanotum narrower than the pronotum, the lateral lobes of the thoracic tergites not markedly angular. Minor soldier slightly paler, head subrectangular, the fontanelle behind the midpoint, the labrum narrower; mandibles slender and elongate, about two thirds of the head capsule length, with fine teeth behind the middle of the inner margin of the left mandible; postmentum elongated, about three times as long as wide.
